fbr_individual.label: SSI federal payment, individual, per month (2026)

fbr_individual_2027.label: SSI federal payment, individual, per month (2027)

fbr_couple.label: SSI federal payment, couple, per month (2026)
fbr_couple.note: Derived from the published couple PMV of $517.00 (one third of the couple rate plus $20). Confirm against SSA's 2026 COLA fact sheet.

fbr_couple_2027.label: SSI federal payment, couple, per month (2027)

infrequent_unearned_per_quarter.label: Infrequent or irregular unearned income excluded per calendar quarter

infrequent_earned_per_quarter.label: Infrequent or irregular earned income excluded per calendar quarter

earned_income_exclusion.label: Earned income exclusion per month (then half of the rest)

pmv_individual.label: Presumed maximum value of in-kind support, individual (2026)

pmv_individual_2027.label: Presumed maximum value of in-kind support, individual (2027)
pmv_individual_2027.note: One third of the 2027 federal benefit rate, plus $20 (20 CFR 416.1140); SSA uses the new value for the January and February checks after a cost-of-living increase (POMS SI 02005.001 E.4.c).

pmv_couple.label: Presumed maximum value of in-kind support, couple (2026)

pmv_couple_2027.label: Presumed maximum value of in-kind support, couple (2027)
pmv_couple_2027.note: One third of the 2027 federal benefit rate, plus $20 (20 CFR 416.1140); SSA uses the new value for the January and February checks after a cost-of-living increase (POMS SI 02005.001 E.4.c).

vtr_individual_2027.label: One-third reduction, individual (2027)
vtr_individual_2027.note: One third of the 2027 federal benefit rate (20 CFR 416.1131); SSA uses the new value for the January and February checks after a cost-of-living increase (POMS SI 02005.001 E.4.c).

vtr_couple_2027.label: One-third reduction, couple (2027)
vtr_couple_2027.note: One third of the 2027 federal benefit rate (20 CFR 416.1131); SSA uses the new value for the January and February checks after a cost-of-living increase (POMS SI 02005.001 E.4.c).

able_annual_limit.label: ABLE contributions per year from all sources (2026)

able_resource_exclusion.label: ABLE balance not counted toward savings

able_onset_age.label: ABLE eligibility: disability began before this age (from Jan 1, 2026)

ism_food_removed_on.label: Date food stopped counting as in-kind support

rma_lag_months.label: Months between receiving income and the check it changes

survey_unsure.label: US adults unsure whether medical fundraising affects benefits

able_newly_eligible.label: People newly potentially eligible for ABLE accounts from Jan 1, 2026 (about 8 million under the original law)

ssi_jan2025_adults.label: Adults 18 to 64 receiving SSI, each on blindness or disability (January 2025)
